status: DESCRIPTION ONLY - nothing registered, no position follows from it

definitions.data: CBOE plain session files through the cap date; *.yfinance.csv excluded; the grid's completeness rule; market clock = CBOE book stamp; one distinct book per quote stamp
definitions.fills: buy at the ask of the entry snapshot; every exit at the bid of the snapshot where its rule triggers; settle = the grid's convention (|last-snapshot spot - K|), official-close check beside it
definitions.E1: one entry per session at the snapshot nearest 10:25:00 ET on the market clock within 7.5 min (the earlier refresh's entry, unchanged)
definitions.E2: every distinct snapshot with market clock 10:00-11:30 ET inclusive; ATM call and ATM put at each
definitions.pooled: ATM call + ATM put (no directional skill assumed); OTM1 pooled = 1-strike-OTM call + put; every leg also alone
definitions.B_rules: loss line {none,-20,-30,-50}% x {clock +15/+25/+40/+60m; target +25/+50/+100% with a +60m clock fallback}; first trigger wins; exit at that snapshot's bid
definitions.t: cluster-robust t of the pooled mean, clustered by session (G/(G-1) small-sample factor)

calm_window.source: settled daily closes, close to close

settle_reference_check.note: the grid's settle spot is the last recorded book's spot, stamped a few minutes before 16:00 ET

looks.cells_breakdown: 3 drawdown levels + 3 gain levels + 2 peak-time readings + 28 rules per group
